profile.intro: Mehir. Developer, tinkerer and student from Bangladesh. I like programming, Linux, open source, systems, networking and technology.

projects.name: Omarchy Tide Island
projects.desc: Swaps the Omarchy bar for a Dynamic-Island-style overlay with one keypress, plus wallpaper and theme pickers.

projects.name: OmaNet
projects.desc: Omarchy bar plugin that controls Android USB reverse tethering through GNirehtet, with systemd service integration.

projects.name: Local Chess
projects.desc: Play chess with friends nearby, no internet needed. Connects over Bluetooth or local Wi-Fi for real-time local multiplayer.

langs.label: HTML
langs.role: The application shell and structure. The site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript: no framework, no dependencies, hash routing so it works on GitHub Pages.

langs.label: Rust
langs.role: No Rust runs in the live site yet. An experimental WebAssembly prototype (a Mandelbrot renderer using wasm-bindgen) is kept in experiments/rust. It has not been built or tested.

langs.label: Python
langs.role: tools/build.py generates manifest.json, the whitelist of files Code Mode may show, and refuses anything that looks like a secret. It runs on my machine, not in your browser.

langs.label: Java
langs.role: No Java runs in the live site. A TeaVM prototype (Java compiled to JavaScript) is kept in experiments/java. It has not been built or tested, and I have not found a practical role for Java in a static site yet.

langs.label: C
langs.role: The syntax highlighter in Code Mode. src/c/tokenizer.c is freestanding C compiled to a ~4 KB WebAssembly module, loaded only when Code Mode opens.

langs.label: Ruby
langs.role: tools/validate_content.rb checks data/content.json (required fields, https links) before the manifest is built. It runs on my machine, not in your browser.
